d: Company Description The World of Herbs (W.L.L.) is a Bahrain-based company headquartered in Manama, focused on herbal products and wellness solutions. The organization is committed to offering high-quality, natural products that promote healthier lifestyles and holistic well-being. The World of Herbs (W.L.L.) values innovation, ethical sourcing, and sustainable business practices. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that support growth, customer satisfaction, and brand reputation across local and regional markets.

Role Description The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is a full-time, hybrid role based in Manama, with the flexibility to work remotely for part of the time. The CEO will oversee overall company strategy, financial performance, and daily operations, ensuring alignment with the organization’s mission and growth objectives. Responsibilities include leading the executive team, setting and monitoring business targets, driving sales and market expansion, and maintaining strong relationships with key partners and stakeholders. The CEO will also ensure effective governance, manage risks, approve major investments, and represent the company in high-level negotiations and public forums. This role involves close collaboration with department heads to optimize operational efficiency, enhance customer experience, and develop long-term strategic plans.
q: li
Strong Finance and Business Planning skills, with the ability to manage budgets, investments, and financial reporting.
li
Proven experience in Operations Management, ensuring efficient processes, resource allocation, and performance improvement.
li
Demonstrated Sales and market development expertise, including building revenue strategies and expanding into new segments.
li
Advanced Strategic Planning capabilities to define vision, set priorities, and drive sustainable growth.
li
Extensive senior leadership experience, preferably as a CEO or in a comparable executive role.
li
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
li
Experience in FMCG, retail, herbal products, or wellness industries is an advantage.
li
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Management, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.

d: About Saadiyat Island Rotana Resort & Villas

Set on the spectacular shores of Saadiyat Island, Saadiyat Island Rotana Resort & Villas offers an exceptional resort experience where genuine hospitality, attention to detail and high standards come together.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Head Housekeeping Supervisor to join our Housekeeping team. This is an opportunity for a hands-on hospitality professional who takes pride in immaculate standards, enjoys developing colleagues and understands how an outstanding room experience contributes to lasting guest satisfaction.
r: As a Head Housekeeping Supervisor, you will support the daily Housekeeping operation and ensure guest rooms and assigned areas consistently meet Rotana’s cleanliness, presentation, safety and service standards.
Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of Housekeeping Attendants, ensuring tasks are effectively allocated and completed to the required standard.
Inspect guest rooms and assigned areas to ensure cleanliness, presentation and compliance with Rotana and hotel quality standards.
Monitor room status, including VIP rooms, DND rooms, arrivals and departures, and maintain effective communication with Front Office to support timely room release.
Respond to guest requests and concerns promptly and professionally, ensuring appropriate follow-up and a positive guest experience.
Lead, guide and motivate Housekeeping colleagues, providing day-to-day coaching, feedback and support to maintain consistent performance.
Ensure special guest requests and room requirements are properly communicated, prepared and followed through.
Monitor housekeeping supplies, equipment and operational requirements, ensuring appropriate stock levels and efficient use of resources.
Report maintenance issues, damaged items and lost-and-found items promptly and ensure established procedures are followed.
Support departmental training and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen service delivery and colleague capability.
Promote safe working practices and ensure the proper use, storage and handling of housekeeping chemicals and equipment.
Support Rotana’s Health, Safety and Sustainability initiatives, including compliance requirements, training, emergency drills and departmental targets.
Work closely with Front Office, Engineering and other departments to maintain an efficient operation and consistently high guest standards.
Previous experience in Housekeeping within a hotel or resort environment, with supervisory experience strongly preferred.
Good knowledge of guest room cleaning, room inspection and housekeeping operating standards.
Strong supervisory and people-management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a multicultural team, reflecting Rotana’s emphasis on clear communication, fairness and teamwork.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining consistently high cleanliness and presentation standards.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to interact effectively with guests and colleagues.
The ability to organize daily priorities and remain effective in a busy, high-occupancy resort environment.
A guest-focused approach with the ability to handle requests and concerns professionally.
Good awareness of workplace Health & Safety practices, including the safe handling of housekeeping chemicals and equipment.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and public holidays according to operational requirements.
A positive, hands-on attitude with a strong sense of ownership, teamwork and pride in delivering high standards.

d: HanmiGlobal Saudi is looking for a friendly and professional Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our clients and visitors, setting a positive tone for the company. As a Receptionist, you will manage the front desk operations, greet and assist visitors, handle phone calls, and provide administrative support to various departments. Your excellent communication skills and customer service orientation will help create a welcoming environment for both employees and guests. This role requires multitasking and organizational abilities as you will be managing various responsibilities, including scheduling appointments, maintaining the reception area, and ensuring that all inquiries are handled efficiently. If you are a proactive individual with a passion for helping others and creating a positive atmosphere, we encourage you to apply for this essential role within our organization.
q: li
Diploma / associate degree or equivalent; additional education is a plus.
li
Proven experience as a Receptionist or in a similar customer service role.
li
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
li
Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask.
li
Proficient in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
li
Positive attitude and a focus on providing exceptional customer service.
li
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle challenging situations calmly.
li
Knowledge of office management systems and procedures is preferred.
li
Saudi National is required as per the SA labor law.
r: Greet visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
Answer incoming calls, direct them to the appropriate personnel, and take messages as necessary.
Manage scheduling, including appointments and conference room bookings.
Maintain a tidy and organized reception area and ensure it reflects the company’s professionalism.
Assist with administrative tasks, such as filing, data entry, and managing office supplies.
Handle inquiries and direct them to the relevant departments as needed.
Provide support for special projects and events as required.
